title: MyUNFrepo
summary: A student coursework repository of Jupyter notebooks for a UNF/DAMO630 assignment applying machine learning and synthetic data techniques to a tabular dataset. The notebook imports SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer along with sdmetrics QualityReport/DiagnosticReport to fit synthesizers, generate synthetic data, and evaluate its quality.
evidence: Group#03_DAMO630_29_Assignment01.ipynb:1003-1006 fits CTGANSynthesizer, samples data; line 829 fits GaussianCopulaSynthesizer
